stem: What happened as a result of someone finding a bottle that had been released by students in Hawaii in 2007?

options.label: F
options.text: The bottle experiment quickly spread to other schools.

options.label: G
options.text: People around the world were encouraged to find pen pals.

options.label: H
options.text: Students tried to send messages in bottles to their classmates.

options.label: J
options.text: Two people living in different parts of the world became friends.
